summary: The filing is a Form 6-K from VCI Global Ltd, reporting the exercise of pre-funded warrants into ordinary shares at a nominal price of $0.0001 per share on June 3, 2026. A total of 818,258 warrants were exercised by multiple holders, resulting in post-exercise shareholdings ranging from 0.050% to 4.326%. The warrants were originally issued under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated November 10, 2025, and are subject to beneficial ownership limitations of 4.99% or 9.99%. The shares were issued in reliance on a Section 4(a)(2) exemption. This is a routine warrant exercise, not a special situation.
